text:
Marta: Quick brain dump 1: want to add lightweight "view hints" to saved queries so teams can attach routing/quota + sampling preferences to a saved console view. Will sketch API soon, want early reactions.
Jordan: Love it. For canaries we need saved views to declare sampling intensity (e.g., trace=1%, eval=20%) so our telemetry pipeline can automatically ramp fidelity.
Matt: UI idea: on list cards show a slim metadata line: 'route=r-42 | quota=1.2k tpm | sample:trace=1%' with a hover that expands to a preview modal explaining effect. Keep main list compact.
Lee: Backend constraints: two implementation options - 1) extend saved_queries table with extra columns, or 2) create saved_view_hints table linked by saved_query_id. Prefer option 2 to avoid migrating all clients.
Simone: Telemetry naming: distinguish trace vs event vs eval sampling. Also note sampling semantics differ: upstream agents may do probabilistic vs deterministic bucketing. Need clear contract.
Marta: Proposed minimal hint keys: routing_hint (route_id), quota_est (tokens_per_min), telemetry_trace_pct, telemetry_eval_pct, fallback_routes (ordered list). Example (informal): "routing_hint: r-42, quota_est: 1200, telemetry_trace_pct: 1, telemetry_eval_pct: 10, fallback_routes: [r-99,r-10]"
Lee: We don't allow arrays in flat columns; if we do separate table we can store fallback_routes as JSON string but that adds parsing. I'm fine with small JSON column behind the hints table.
Jordan: Operational ask: saved-view-driven routing must be opt-in per-org. We don't want random saved views accidentally steering production traffic.
Marta: Agreed. Defaults: hints are ignored unless org flag enabled or the view is owned by an admin/owner. We should also show a prominent banner when a view has active routing hints.
Matt: UX: when exporting/sharing a view, strip routing_hint unless recipient has permissions. Otherwise you can leak traffic steering.
Simone: Audit requirement: every change to view hints needs an audit event (who/id/timestamp/old->new) and also an event when a view's hints result in non-default telemetry (so data scientists can interpret sampling shifts).
Lee: API sketch: POST /api/v1/saved_views/:id/hints {"routing_hint":"r-42","quota_est":"1200","telemetry_trace_pct":"1","telemetry_eval_pct":"10","fallback_routes":"r-99,r-10"} We'll gate behind feature.saved_view_hints.
Jordan: For rollouts we also want a per-view prioritized route list + capacity threshold so the runtime knows when to fall back. Eg: route=r-42@0.9 means use r-42 while healthy >=90% capacity.
Marta: Good call. Add optional health_threshold_pct on hint.
ops-bot: feature flag created: feature.saved_view_hints for org=redwood-dogfood
Matt: :thumbsup:
Marta: Next steps: I'll capture this in a short RFC with UI mocks, API surface, RBAC rules, migration plan. Jordan + Lee to pair on a draft API tomorrow. Simone to list telemetry semantics.
Jordan: I'll pair with Lee tomorrow AM and add the API example to the RFC.
